تستجهلون (form X)
# تَسْتَجْهِلُونَ (tastajhilūna) /tas.tad͡ʒ.hi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# تُسْتَجْهَلُونَ (tustajhalūna) /tus.tad͡ʒ.ha.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
